thoughts.thought: That kindness from {subject} matters to me. I could bring them something to show that it reached me.
thoughts.dreamThought: Waking, I picture returning {subject}'s kindness instead of carrying it silently. A small gift could make that feeling visible.

thoughts.thought: I am uneasy about that kindness from {subject}. I could challenge what it means instead of accepting it without question.
thoughts.dreamThought: Waking, I imagine that kindness from {subject} becoming an obligation. That is only a possibility, but I could question what their gesture means.

thoughts.thought: I reached out to {subject}. Offering to help could give us a reason to spend a little more time together.
thoughts.dreamThought: Waking, I picture feeling at ease with {subject}. I could offer help and see whether we can share another moment after my earlier kindness.

thoughts.thought: Being kind to {subject} does not mean I trust them. I could make that boundary clear instead of leaving my gesture to speak for me.
thoughts.dreamThought: Waking, I imagine my kindness to {subject} being mistaken for a promise. I could explain my limits before that imagined possibility becomes my worry.

thoughts.thought: I do not want {subject} to think I will accept being treated that way. I could stand up to them.
thoughts.dreamThought: Waking, I picture myself finding words I could say to {subject}. I could stand up for myself over how they treated me.

thoughts.thought: What happened with {subject} hurt. A small gift might leave us a way back toward each other without pretending nothing happened.
thoughts.dreamThought: Waking, I imagine a less painful next encounter with {subject}. A small gift might open that possibility without erasing the hurt I remember.

thoughts.thought: I do not like how I treated {subject}. Offering help might be a start toward making things less difficult between us.
thoughts.dreamThought: Waking, I picture a kinder way I could behave toward {subject}. I cannot undo what I did, but I could offer help next time.

thoughts.thought: I am not ready to back down over what happened with {subject}. I could press the issue instead of letting it rest.
thoughts.dreamThought: Waking, I imagine standing my ground with {subject} again. I could press the issue; the thought of backing down still does not appeal to me.

thoughts.thought: I keep returning to this memory: {memory} Perhaps I could find a different way to approach {subject}.
thoughts.dreamThought: Waking, I imagine another approach to {subject}, prompted by this earlier memory: {memory} It is a possibility, not something else that happened.

responses.gift: I'd like you to have this. Thank you for what you did.
responses.quietGift: This is for you. Your kindness stayed with me.
responses.help: I'd like to do something kind for you too. Can I give you a hand?
responses.quietHelp: You were kind to me. Let me give you a hand.
responses.confront: I want to handle this myself. I want to make my own choices.
responses.quietConfront: That gesture made me uncomfortable. I need to say so.

responses.gift: I wanted to do something else for you. I'd like you to have this.

responses.confront: I chose to do that for you. Please don't mistake it for a promise of more.
